notices.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Gets Firefight Mode In Free Update This Winter
notices.contentSnippet:
Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting the fan-favorite Firefight mode via a free update this winter, an Xbox Wire post announces. The update will allow players to team up in cooperative wave-based PvE.
Firefight, which debuted in Halo 3: ODST, lets up to four players team up to survive waves of enemies. The mode has become a popular staple and has appeared in multiple Halo games, but this will be the first time that it has been retroactively added to the original entry. 
Xbox FanFest attendees, a global multi-city event, will be the first to go hands-on with Campaign Evolved’s take on Firefight. Additionally, more details about Firefight will be shared during Halo Fest in Seattle on December 12-13, where the mode will also be playable for attendees.
You can read our review of Halo: Campaign Evolved here. Subscribers can also learn about the game's development by reading our cover story from this summer. Be sure to also read the recent Halo news that Microsoft is handing the franchise to Activision after gutting long-time developer Halo Studios.
